newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African boss to head merged JCI-Lonrho - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.African boss to head merged JCI-Lonrho - paper.

text.p: Terence Wilkinson, the head of conglomerate Lonrho Plc's South African operations, will be chief executive of any eventual merger of the group with mining house JCI Ltd, Business Times newspaper said on Sunday.
The report, which quoted unnamed sources, said the appointment of Wilkinson was one of the few areas of common agreement to emerge so far from the talks.
The firms were also considering joint-chairmanship of a merged firm between JCI's Mzi Khumalo and Lonrho's John Craven.
JCI and Lonrho confirmed last month that they were in talks on a possible merger which could create a mining company with market capitalisation of more than $3 billion.
The firms have said the talks are ongoing and still in their early stages.
